conclusion: After consumed Gate #487 produced NO_PREDICTIVE_SIGNAL_STRICT_SINGLETON_SUBSET for frozen SW0, owner-free work continued without any further protected-result access. A separately preregistered synthetic-only low-freedom replacement study evaluated nine calibration-oriented variants across 5 synthetic worlds, field sizes 5-9, five fixed seeds, 500 races per world-field-seed cell (62,500 synthetic races total). Frozen eligibility required finite probability sanity, worst-cell top-label ECE10 <= 0.15, and pooled ordered-top3 NLL / winner log-loss / winner Brier no worse than sequential uniform. R0_T2 (score-only Plackett-Luce with temperature 2.0) was frozen as the single synthetic winner: pooled ordered-top3 NLL 4.976936517977866 vs uniform 5.253726252751261; winner log-loss 1.824968096578071 vs 1.9247547299467014; winner Brier 0.8196816519163184 vs 0.850873015873017; top-label ECE10 0.007189465072259129; worst-cell ECE10 0.1093105532559407. This is synthetic engineering evidence only; the synthetic worlds are design assumptions, not real-Keirin validation. No model promotion or protected evaluation is authorized. Gate #487 is not reused and A+B observed outcomes must not be reused as a fresh validation set for this post-outcome replacement selection.
